name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in Barcelona, attending the Spanish Grand Prix every year with his father. He pursued a degree in Marketing and Communications, always with the goal of working in Formula 1. After graduating, Ricardo gained experience at several smaller motorsport teams, focusing on social media management and sponsor activation. He joined Haas F1 Team two years ago, quickly proving his ability to develop engaging campaigns and build strong relationships with partners. Ricardo is known for his detail-oriented approach and his ability to think strategically, ensuring that marketing efforts align with the team's overall objectives.

He excels at translating complex technical information into compelling narratives for fans. Ricardo's pragmatic nature helps him stay focused on delivering measurable results, while his experience allows him to navigate the challenges of the fast-paced F1 environment with confidence. He's considered a valuable asset to the team, bridging the gap between the technical side of racing and the public image of Haas.

physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.
